title.narrative: African Activist for Climate Justice (AACJ) Project in Somalia

description.narrative: Natural Justice (NJ), through the AACJ project in Somalia seeks to ensure inclusive and human-rights based approach to climate justice, by working with a strong movement and a network of climate actors. It targets marginalized and climate change vulnerable communities of Somalia, grassroot networks and Civil Society Organizations (CSOs), government actors and the private sector. The aim of the project is to strengthen, influence, and inspire climate justice, by creating a platform where a diverse network of actors can proactively engage in decision-making, policy influencing and developing climate narratives for the realization of broad-based change.
